note: This ratifies the ACCEPTANCE RULE only. It is a separate, additional, market-scoped contract; it is not the existing 3-market regime_replay_harness/v1 (config/regime_replay_harness_contract.json), which is unmodified and unweakened by this contract (its own required_markets=[US,KR,CRYPTO] stays exactly as-is; this contract does not replace, extend, or bypass it).
market_independence_rule: Each market's PIT acceptance status is evaluated and reported independently. An incomplete or NOT_ACCEPTED status on one market (including CRYPTO, whose normalization stays unratified) never blocks, delays, or changes another market's status.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: REAL_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: The evaluated sequence must be built exclusively from a population bundle whose schema_version, mode, and per-record evidence_class byte-match the real regime.us_historical_replay_population / regime.kr_historical_replay_population output contract. A caller-supplied or hand-constructed sequence that does not carry this exact provenance receives zero credit toward acceptance, regardless of its content.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: REQUIRED_5_OF_5_AXES
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: Every evaluated date must have all five required axes (TREND, BREADTH, RISK_VOL, LIQUIDITY, LEADERSHIP) DEFINED. A date with any UNDEFINED axis is excluded from the accepted sequence, not substituted or carried forward.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: NO_LOOKAHEAD_PIT_VALIDATION_PASS
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: Every evaluated date's own no_lookahead_attestation from the population bundle must be present and independently re-checked (every consulted source date <= that date's requested date), matching the same lookahead-violation re-derivation pattern already implemented in regime.us_historical_replay_population, regime.kr_historical_replay_population, and regime.combined_shadow_historical_replay.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: DETERMINISTIC_RERUN_BYTE_IDENTICAL
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: Re-running regime.decision_authority.replay_common_v1 on the identical validated sequence must produce a canonically byte-identical report on every rerun.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: RATIFIED_CLASSIFICATION_AND_HYSTERESIS_EXACT_REPLAY
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: Classification and hysteresis must come exclusively from an unmodified call to regime.decision_authority.replay_common_v1, which implements the existing RATIFIED_PAPER_BASELINE_V1 common_v1_alignment values verbatim. No new threshold, weight, or hysteresis rule is introduced by this contract or its validator.

pit_accepted_conditions.name: ALL_FOUR_REGIMES_OBSERVED_AT_LEAST_ONCE
pit_accepted_conditions.rule: Across the full accepted real sequence (never a caller-selected sub-range), RISK_ON, NEUTRAL, RISK_OFF, and STRESS must each appear at least once among the confirmed_regime values replay_common_v1 actually produced. No episode date may be pre-selected, declared in policy, or chosen after seeing the classifier's output; the validator consumes the population bundle's full requested_dates range exactly as supplied and reports which regime(s), if any, never occurred.
